Bridging Canada and Japan

Health care in Japan, coordinated from Vancouver

Pacific Medical Concierge helps people in Canada explore health screenings and medical services in Japan. We are a non-medical coordinator: we guide you through the process, and qualified medical professionals in Japan make the clinical decisions and provide your care.

Why Pacific Medical Concierge

1A Vancouver-based point of contact.

You deal with someone here in Canada, who bridges the distance, language and systems between you and Japan.

2Japan-side experience.

Our Japan-side contact has experience coordinating medical tourism, and works with us to identify appropriate options.

3Process and communication first.

Our focus is the practical process — clear steps, clear responsibilities, and communication you can follow — not just travel bookings.

4Costs explained before you decide.

Costs vary substantially by institution and service, so we do not publish prices. You will receive the relevant pricing information and have the opportunity to review it before deciding whether to proceed.

Services

Health Screenings (Ningen Dock)

Health screenings in Japan — ningen dock — are our main service. We arrange your screening at medical institutions in Japan.

Stem Cell Services

We coordinate inquiries about stem cell treatments offered by medical institutions in Japan. These treatments are not authorized by Health Canada, and their safety and effectiveness are not established. The provider assesses suitability, explains the risks and costs, and provides any treatment. We make no claims about results or effectiveness.

Documents and Language Support

As part of coordinating your case, we help with translation of medical documents between English and Japanese, and clear English-language summaries of your results — drawing on professional experience in medical translation and proofreading.

Advanced Treatments

Advanced treatments such as PET scans, Gamma Knife and ZAP-X radiosurgery are offered at certain institutions in Japan. We coordinate access: each case is reviewed by the provider, who confirms whether the treatment can be offered.

About

Pacific Medical Concierge was founded by a small group of individuals who share a passion for helping people in Canada access health screenings and medical services in Japan — provided by Japanese medical institutions, coordinated from Vancouver.

Through our Japan-side partner — who has coordinated medical travel for international patients and built long-standing relationships with hospitals and specialists across Japan, including connections formed through work with advanced treatment technologies such as Gamma Knife radiosurgery — we connect you to that network and coordinate each step, from exploring options to provider review, arrangements and follow-up.

We are coordinators, not medical providers. All clinical decisions are made by the qualified medical professionals who provide your care in Japan.

Frequently Asked Questions

What is a ningen dock?

Ningen dock is Japan's comprehensive preventive health screening — a detailed set of examinations and tests that check your overall health and look for problems early, usually completed in a single day.

A typical course includes:

  • Physical measurements and blood pressure
  • Extensive blood and urine tests
  • Vision and hearing checks
  • Electrocardiogram (ECG)
  • Chest X-ray and lung-function test
  • Abdominal ultrasound
  • Stomach examination (endoscopy or barium X-ray)
  • A doctor's consultation on your results

Many courses also offer options such as CT or MRI imaging and additional cancer-screening tests. Exact contents vary by course — we confirm what is included in the options proposed for you.

Do I need Japanese health insurance or to live in Japan?

No. The screenings we coordinate are private, self-paid services, open to people visiting from Canada. You do not need Japanese health insurance or residency.

Is Pacific Medical Concierge a medical provider?

No. We are coordinators, not medical providers. We connect you with providers in Japan and coordinate the arrangements.

Which hospitals and doctors do you work with?

We coordinate through our Japan-side partner with institutions in Japan. We do not publish a list of names. Once we understand what you need, we propose specific options for your case, and the provider reviews your case and confirms whether the service can be offered.

How much does it cost?

We do not publish prices, because the right option — and its cost — depends on your case. Before anything is booked, you receive the proposed arrangements and their costs, and you decide whether to go ahead. Nothing proceeds without your agreement.

How does payment work?

At present, payment for the services arranged is made on the Japan side.

Will my screening report be in English?

Your screening report may be provided in English. If it is issued in Japanese, we will have it translated into English for you.

What if a screening finds something?

The provider explains your results. If you would like to explore further care in Japan, we can coordinate that inquiry — each case is reviewed by the provider. Once you are home, we can introduce you to a doctor from our network across Canada for follow-up.

What should I know about the stem cell services?

We coordinate inquiries about stem cell injections in Japan. Suitability, risks, and any treatment are the provider's responsibility, as described under Stem Cell Services above. We make no claims about results or effectiveness.

Do I need to send medical records to make an inquiry?

No. An initial inquiry asks only for your basic contact details and the service you are interested in.

How far in advance should I contact you?

Please contact us at least a month before the date you have in mind — a month to a month and a half ahead is ideal.

How quickly will I hear back?

We reply to inquiries within two business days.

Privacy Policy

Pacific Medical Concierge respects your privacy. This policy explains how we handle personal information when you contact us or use our services.

Information we may collect

When you contact us, we may collect your name, contact information and details about the services you are interested in. If you choose to proceed, we may need additional information to coordinate with a medical institution. Please do not send medical records in your initial email. We will explain what information is needed and how to share it.

How we use information

We may use your information to respond to inquiries, communicate with you, and coordinate requested services and arrangements.

Sharing information

With your consent, we may share relevant information with medical institutions, our Japan-side coordination contact, interpreters or travel professionals when needed for the arrangements you request. Some recipients may be located outside Canada, including in Japan. Information shared with recipients in Japan will be held outside Canada and may be subject to the laws of Japan.

Cookies and analytics

We use Google Analytics to understand how visitors use this website. Google Analytics uses cookies to collect information about visits, such as pages viewed and time spent, in a form that does not directly identify you. You can disable cookies in your browser settings, or opt out using Google's opt-out tools.

Your choices and questions

To ask about your personal information, request access or correction, or discuss withdrawing consent, contact: Pacific Medical Concierge — care@pacmedconcierge.com

Disclaimer: Pacific Medical Concierge is a coordination service, not a medical provider. The information on this website is general information only and is not medical advice. All clinical decisions — including whether a service or treatment is suitable for you or can be offered — are made by the medical institutions and professionals who provide care in Japan. Nothing on this website guarantees the availability of any service or the outcome of any treatment.
